title: Note names
goal: Learn the seven letters C D E F G A B and find notes by name.

steps.title: Seven letters
steps.text: Piano notes use seven letters: C D E F G A B. After B the letters start again at C. The names are on the white keys.

steps.title: Walk up from C
steps.text: Start at middle C and go up the white keys: C D E F G A B, and the next C is higher. Press the hear button to listen.

steps.title: Walk up
steps.text: Press each lit key in turn and say its name.

steps.title: Walk back down
steps.text: Now come back down from B to C.

steps.title: No letters now
steps.text: From here the letters are hidden. If you get lost, find a group of two black keys: the key to its left is C.
